svg.title: KS-23 animated top view
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping top view of KS-23 (Stop-and-go queue and resume) from its esmini replay at the parameter defaults, 0.0 to 11.1 s: Stop-and-go: the lead stands, then moves off. Plot: lead speed (km/h). Events: ego and lead stand, 8 m apart at 0.0 s; lead moves off at 1.5 m/s² at 5.1 s; loop ends at 11.1 s. Layer 2 fixes the road and the other road users. The ego stands: its file gives it speed 0; the item under test drives it in layer 1 and on the bench. Cars: Kenney Racing Pack (CC0).
